༄༅/ /brgya bzhi'i cho ga mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lugs dngos kyi brgya bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis/gzugs brnyan gyi brgya bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis/ting nge

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// brgya bzhi'i cho ga mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lugs dngos kyi brgya bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis/ gzugs brnyan gyi brgya bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi brgya bzhi dang lnga'i phyag len 'don cha 'grigs chags su bkod pa 'di ltar rgyas bsdus lnga po 'byor pa dang bstun mdzod/ 'don cha gzhung la khyad par med do//

"$ na mo shākya mu ne badz+ra pā ṇi ye// thub dbang gsang bdag bcas la phyag 'tshal nas// mdo sngags zung 'jug brgya bzhi khyer bder bkod// 'gro la phan phyir bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs// gong du mchod gzhir pad 'dab bcu bzhi'am/ yang na tshom bu bkod steng maṇ+ḍal khar// thub dbang sku bshams de yi mdun de ru// mchod pa sna bdun spyi ltar bshams par bya// 'og tu sa stegs steng du rdal mtshon nam// yang na gzhi steng shog bur bris pas chog /gru bzhir gsum rim steng du 'dab brgyad dbus// thub pa'i phyag g.yas bcag khru gang gi tshad// phyag sor bzhi la bdud bzhi'i gzugs de ni// sngags pas byas na 'jim gzugs byed srol 'dug /de la mi gzugs dkar ser dmar nag bzhi// de la phyag mtshan la sogs mi dgos so// btsun las byed na tsakli gzhung nas bshad// zan nam yungs rtog sogs la btsugs nas bzhag /phyag mthil sder nang yon bdag de yi gzugs// ngar mi changs bus bskor la gos dum bsko na// de mthar tshwa tshwa brgya yis bskor ba ni// tshwa tshwa 'debs chog byin rlabs sogs mi dgos// yig drug 'don cing btab pas 'brus pa yin// de rgyab mar me brgya yis bskor ba dang*// de rgyab lha bshos chung ngu brgyad pa ni// zan du ma 'dra ba'i mtheb skyu brgya yis bskor// de rgyab ngar mi brgya dang tshangs bu brgya// de ni yon bdag 'byor pa rab rnams kyis// brgya bzhi dngos su bshams pa rgyas pa yin// de las cung zhig bsdu bar 'dod pa na// mtheb skyu changs bu gnyis ni mi dgos so// yang na gtor ma'i tshab la mtheb skyu dang*// ngar mi'i tshab la tshangs bus chog par bshad// yang na gtor ma shar dang mar me lho// tshwa tshwa nub dang ngar mi byang du bshams// 'byor pa 'bring la gzugs brnyan brgya bzhi ste// dang po tshwa tshwa nyer lnga sngon ltab ste// de rgyab 'grim pa'am yungs kyi gong bu'i nang*// sdong bu lnga re btsugs pa'i mar me lnga// de rgyab lha bshos nang ni ngar mi yang*// nyi shu rtsa lnga re yis bskor bar bya// de rgyab phyogs bzhi mda' 'am smyug rgod la// me long bzhi btags gzugs brnyan brgya bzhi tshang*// de las bsdu na tshwa tshwa bcu yis chog

/mar me bzhi la sdong bu lnga re'am// bshos bu ngar mi yang ni bcu re bya// gzhung la don cha bcu res tshangs zhes gsungs// de nyid don tshe lag tu me long bzung*// me long phyi zhing lan bcu bstan pas 'thus// de ni gzugs brnyan brgya bzhi rgyas bsdus so// tha ma ting nge 'dzin gyi brgya bzhi ni// tshwa tshwa gcig na bde bzhin mar me gcig /ngar mi lha bshos gnyis ni bzhi re bya// ting nge 'dzin gyi brgya re yid kyis sprul// 'dod chog rnams ni tshar gcig 'don pa ste// dmigs pa gsal na des kyang 'grub pa ste// mi gsal bar ni phan thogs chung bar bshad// 'on kyang mo lung sel tsam 'ong ba yin// de ltar rgyas bsdus 'bring sogs gang byed kyang*// gong du thub pa'i sku dar mchod pa dang*// 'og tu thub pa'i phyag mthil ngar mi dang*// phyag sor bdud bzhi'i gzugs ni kun la dgos// de nas mchod pa thams cad bran byas te// bdag bskyed spyan ras gzigs kyi bsgom bzlas dang*// mdun bskyed thugs spyan drangs mchod bstod ni// khungs btsun mi bskyod zhabs kyis mdzad ltar 'don// de nas 'di dag gyer sgom sgrags pas mthus// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ chos rnams ye nas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ las byung 'byung rim brtsegs// de steng snang stong mkha' la 'ja' shar ltar// thub pa'i phyag g.yas yangs shing rgya che ba// mdzub mo'i steng du lha yi bu yi bdud// dkar po lha phrug gzhon nu'i cha byad can// gung mo'i steng du nyon mongs pa yi bdud// dmar po sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams ldan pa// srin lag steng du phung po'i bdud ser po// bram ze'i cha byad rgas shing 'khog pa'i nyams// mthe'u chung steng du 'chi bdag bdud nag po// gshin rje'i cha lugs khro zhing gtum pa'i gzugs// bzhi kas lag na khram zhing zhags pa thogs// rang rang rigs mthun 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor// phyag mthil 'bru mchog ngar gyi mi bo che// phung khams skye mched cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sbyin bdag dngos 'dra dngos las brgya stong lhag

/rang 'dra'i sprul pa gdon gyi grangs mnyam 'phro// tshwa tshwa rnams ni bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po las// 'od 'phros rnam snang dpag med spyan drangs thim// oṃ ā:hūm̐ gis sku gsum lhun grub pa'i// rnam rgyal mchod rten dkar po brgya phrag ni// phung po'i bdud rnams sel ba'i byin rlabs can// bai ro tsa na oṃ gyi byin gyis rlabs// kong bu pad+ma mar khu zla dkyil dbus// sdong bu hūm̐ las ye shes lnga yi me// nyon mongs bdud rnams sel ba'i 'od zer can// badz+ra dī paṃ hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs// 'bru sna'i bshos bu ro brgya nus pa stong*// dkar zlum ri rab tsam pa brgya phrag ni// lha bu'i bdud rnams sel ba'i bcud ldan du// badz+ra nai wi d+ya yi byin gyis brlabs// ngar mi 'phrul gyi mi bo ya mtshan can// glu len gro brdung byed pa brgya phrag ste// 'chi bdag bdud rnams bzlog pa'i stobs ldan du// badz+ra rū pa hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs// rang nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer gyis// mdun gyi thub pa'i thugs kar phog pa yis// thub pa'i thugs las 'od zer 'phros byas pas// dper na nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin// thub pa'i 'khor du khro bo'i tshogs bzhugs pa// spros te gdon gyi tshogs rnams mdun du bkug /bdag dang thub pa'i bka' nyan gsung bsgrub gyur// hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgyas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags rnams kyi = yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i= bden pa chen po'i mthus= lha'i bu'i bdud = nyon mongs pa'i bdud = phung po'i bdud = 'chi bdag gi bdud/ de dag gi rigs dang 'khor du gtogs pa'i bsrung bya sbyin bdag 'di la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa gang yin pa thams 'dir 'chis par gyur cig

/ṭā ki hūm̐ dza: hūm̐ /dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bar snang khams kyang 'gugs byed na// lus can rnams la smos ci dgos// sems med pa yang 'ugs byed na// sems dang ldan pa smos ci dgos// 'dir ni gnod byed 'gug tu gsol// dza:hūm̐ bam̐ ho: hūm̐/ snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre kun// bdud bzhi'i rigs su ma 'dus med// lhas kyang gson la 'dres kyang nyon// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad// mar me brgya ni sbyin pa btang*// ma rig mun pa gsal ba ltar// de ring mar me'i mchod sbyin bya// bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis// sku gdung mchod rten 'dzam gling bkang*// 'gro ba mang po'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs// de bzhin mchod rten tshwa tshwa bzhengs// sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin de// lha lha min 'thab pa'i tshe// lha rnams pham zhing lha min rgyal// brgya byin 'chi bdag bdud kyis zin// tshe 'phos ngan song skye bar shes// shin tu 'jigs shing skrag gyur nas// phyag na rdo rje la zhus pa// kyai ma bcom ldan thugs rje can// bdud bzhi 'dul thabs gang ltar lags// lha yi bu yi bdud kyis ni// lha min dmag drangs g.yul pham gyur// phung po'i bdud kyis lus 'di la// skye rgas na 'chi'i sdug bsngal byung*// 'chi bdag bdud kyis srog bcad cing*// nyon mongs bdud kyis ngan song lhung*// rdo rje 'chang gis bdag la skyobs// zhes zhus gsang ba'i bdag po yis// bcom ldan thub pa nyid la zhus// thub pas brgya bzhi'i cho ga mdzad// lha dbang brgya byin bsnyun las thar// brgya bzhi sbyin par btang ba nges// brgya byin zhes bya'i mtshan yang thogs// sngon gyi srid pa de bzhin du// sbyin bdag bar chad bsal ba'i phyir// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin bzhes slad du// hūm̐/ 'chi bdag bdud dang phung po'i bdud// nyon mongs bdud dang lha bu'i bdud// bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag dpon tshogs// sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin de// 'chi bdag nag po'i bdud kyis zin// bdud bzhi sel ba'i gto dpyad du// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub kyis// brgya bzhi sbyin pa btang bas sangs// lha dbang brgya byin bsnyun las thar// da lta rgyu 'byor yon bdag la// mo ngan rmi ltas ngan pa dang*// mtshan rtsis ngan pa'i gto dpyad du// brgya bzh-i'i yas dang rdzas bsags te// 'byung ba'i bdud bzhi spyan drangs te// thang cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs nas// phyag sor bzhi yi rtse la bzhugs su gsol// kyai/

lha yi bu bdud ni dkar po ste// shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rgyu las byung*// nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po ste// dug lnga nyon mongs sgrib las byung*// phung po'i bdud ni ser po ste// bag chags sgrib pa'i rgyu las byung*// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po ste// rnam smin las kyi sgrib las byung*// de ltar rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /sgrib pa rnam bzhi sbyang ba'i phyir// mchod dang sbyin pa'i gnas nyid ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir dkon mchog gsum// mchod rdzas mar me zhal zas sogs// 'bul zhing tshogs ni rab bsags pas// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib gnyis sbyangs// lha bdud nyon mongs bdud las thar// sbyin pa'i gtor ma rgya chen btang*// 'chi bdag nag po'i bdud las thar// lan chags srog glud 'di bsngos pas// 'chi bdag phung po'i bdud las thar// bdud bzhi sel ba'i gtor mchod 'di// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i byin brlabs dang*// gsang sngags dang ni rigs sngags dang*// bdag gi bsam pa dag pa'i mthus// bdud bzhi'i gnod sems zhi gyur cig /mchod sbyin rgyas pa'i cho ga 'di// bdud bzhi sel ba'i mchog yin te// sngon tshe lha yi lha yi dbang pos mdzad// da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bar chad rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol// bdud sgo tshod la las sgo skyol// sgrib pa mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs// tshogs gnyis bsags pas dag par gyis// bdud tshogs thams cad ma lus pa'i// gtso bo'i bdud chen rnam pa bzhi// snang gsal brgya bzhi'i mchod pa bzhes// mchod sbyin chen po bsngos pa yis// bdud chen bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// gzugs dang phung po 'jig byed pa'i// nad bzhi 'du ba sman gyis gso// bar chad glo bur ye 'grogs rkyen// bgegs kyi rgyal po bdud chen bzhi// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol// dngos dang gzugs brnyan ting 'dzin gyis// bsags shing me long blos sprul pa// byin gyis rlabs shing sbyin btang 'di// bdud chen bzhi la 'bul lags na// 'dir gshegs bzhes te dgyes par mdzod// kyai/

sngon tshe bcom ldan shāka thub kyis// mchod sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru// mchod gtor rdzas dang yas bsags te// phyag sor rtse la mgron bkug nas// bdud bzhi'i mgron la sbyin pa btang*// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// dad can yon bdag phyag mthil du// bzhag ces brjod nas dbang bskur bas// sgrib pa bzhi las gyur pa yi// bdud bzhi bsal te mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis// bden pa'i byin brlabs de ltar lags// da lta bdag dang yon bdag gi /gzugs dang glud chen 'di bsngos te// mtha' ma brgya bzhi'i rdzas kyis bskor// bdud bzhi phyag sor bzhugs pa rnams// mdzub mor lha bdud dkar po nyon// gung mor phung bdud ser po nyon// srin lag nyon bdud dmar po nyon// mthe'u chung 'chi bdag bdud nag nyon// bsags pa'i dam rdzas 'di rnams la// bdag gi ting 'dzin stobs dang ni// phyogs bcu'i dkon mchog bden pa dang*// chos skyong rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis// bdud kyi dmag dang bgegs tshogs rnams// tshim zhing dgyes pa'i sems dang ldan// gdug pa'i sems zhi bde bar mdzod// sngon tshe thub pa chen po'i bka'// brgya bzhi sbyin pa rnams bzhi ste// tshwa tshwa brgya ni tshogs lam la// brten nas skyabs kyi sbyin pa yin// gtor ma brgya ni sbyor lam la// brten nas zang zing sbyin pa yin// mar me brgya ni mthong lam la// brten nas byams pa'i sbyin pa yin// ngar mi brgya ni sgom lam la// brten nas srog gi lan chags sbyong*// de phyir chos kyi sbyin pa yin// sngon tshe brgya byin lus kyi rkyen// ngar mi brgya btang bdud las thar// de bzhin brgya bzhi 'di btang bas// nad dang gdon las thar gyur cig /hūm̐/ 'gro ba ma rig 'khrul pa yi// las la thugs rjes rab gzigs nas// rin chen sna lnga'i sa bsdus nas// 'byung ba chu yis rab sbyar te// ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs nas// sku phor chos kyi dbyings kyi yum// 'bi 'bi thabs dang shes rab sras// gnyis su med par brdabs pa ni// sku gdung mchod rten dpag tu med// sems bskyed che bas khyad par 'phags// bsgyur stobs che bas rlung dang 'dra// rten 'brel kun rdzogs sku yi rten// yon tan ldan te thogs pa med// sku gdung mchod rten thams cad dang*// mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa yi// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas dang*// sems can rnams kyis skyabs su mchi// de phyir dkon mchog gsum po dang*// yi dam chos skyong lha tshogs kyi// sku gsung rten mchog gyur pa rnams// spyi bo'i gtsug tu bskur byas nas// phyag gi gnas su bzung bar bgyis// byin rlabs skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum// phyag gi rten du bzhugs su gsol// deng nas snying po byang chub bar// sems can rnams kyi mgon skyabs su// bde bar gshegs pa rab sprul nas// sems can rnams kyi don la dgongs// 'od dpag med pa'i thugs rje yi// byin gyis brlabs pa'i yon tan la// 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi// phyag gi gnas su bzung bar bgyis// bsod nams rten du bzung bar bgyis// sngon gyi rgyal po sa ri sha pa de// 'chi bdag bdud kyis khyer la khad// tshwa tshwa brgya rtsa brtsam pa yis// sa ri sha pa bdud las thar// sngon gyi de la dpe blangs nas// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di byas pas// bya sprel lcags kyi 'khor lo shig

/btsa' ma dgu rgyug byed pa yi// nub kyi bgegs gnyan bzlog tu gsol/ hūm̐/ mnyam pa nyid kyi zhing khams nas// rin chen pho brang dkyil 'khor nas// rtsi thog snying po mar dang ni// 'bru mar snying po sna tshogs kyis// rgyu yi mchog las byung ba yi// gsal ba'i ye shes mar me dang*// snang zhing gsal ba'i sgron me dang*// nyi ma zla ba la sogs rnams// yul phyogs kun tu gsal byas pas// glog dang skar ma la sogs pa// rin chen rang bzhin cher 'bar ba'i// mar me me las grub pa yi// zla ba chu las grub pa des// 'od kyi snang ba sna tshogs kyis// lho phyogs gdug pa'i kag gnyan dang*// 'byung ba me yi kag las thar// de phyir phan yon dpag tu med// brgya bzhi brtsam pa'i phan yon gyis// khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi /stag gzig gdug pa zhi ba ltar// mar me 'di yi phan yon gyis// 'od gsal snang gsal mer me 'di// ye shes lha la phul ba yis// steng gi skag gnyan bzlog tu gsol// mes ni bar snang gdug pa zhi// thal bas 'od phyogs gdon rnams sel// 'od kyis phyogs rnams kun gsal zhing*// brgya bzhi'i phan yon rab ldan pas// lho phyogs bya sprel me yi gdug pa zhi// lho phyogs me yi dal kha bsgyur// 'byung ba'i nad las thar gyur cig /tsha ba me yi yams nad dang*// gdug pa'i kag gnyan sum brgya dang*// drug cu rtsa bzhi thams cad kun// mar me brgya yi stobs kyis bzlog /brgya bzhi'i phan yon 'di dag gis// rtsub 'khrugs thams cad bsgyur du gsol// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar mdzod// hūm̐/ 'jig rten dag na gnas pa yi// lha dang klu dang lha min gdon// dri za dang ni srul po'i gdon// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye dang*// ma mo gshin rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' la 'phyo dang bar snang 'phyo// sa la gnas rnams ma lus dang*// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// 'byung ba lnga la gnas dang*// bdud bzhi bdud rigs 'khor bcas dang*// ri lung nags tshal la gnas pa dang*// khang stong phug stong la sogs dang*// lha khang mchod rten ri ral rnying pa dang*// rgya gram lam dang la btsas la gnas dang*// 'dzam bu gling la dbang dgos 'dre srin dang*// gdon dang 'byung po ma lus kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di khyer la// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa mi gtong bar// zhi ba'i bsam pas rang rang gnas su dengs// zang zing sbyin pas lus ngag yid gsum tshim// de ltar gtor ma dam pa 'di khyer la// sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' la nyon// phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig

/kyai/ ngar mi rgyu btsal gang du btsal// 'bru sna dgu yi rgyu 'bras ni// byung khung nag po rgya nas byung*// rgya zhing mu med rdzogs su btab// thabs shes glang po'i rmos dor la// gnya' shing thong lcags rol du rmos// brtson 'grus thabs kyis so nam byas// pha dgung sngon gnam gyi char gyis bran// ma sa gzhi'i rlan gyis ngad kyis skyes// bu ni 'bru sna dgu ru srid// zor gyis brngas nas thabs kyis brdungs// rin chen mdzes pa'i snod du blugs// yan lag brgyad ldan chab kyis bran// rnal 'byor bdag gis phyag tu phul// yon bdag glud du ngar mi byas// 'bru sna dgu yi ngar mi 'di// spyan bzang gzi mdangs ya la la// shangs bzang dri zhim thu lu lu// tshems bzang dung ltar khrigs se khrig /ljags bzang glog ltar khyugs se khyug /gzugs bzang nyi ltar lhags se lhag /smra mkhas de ni sa la la// 'gro mkhas de ni zu lu lu// gos bzang de ni lhubs se lhub// dbang po rnam lnga 'di la tshang*// skye mched bcu gnyis 'di la tshang*// mi bas glud bzang ya la la// rje bas kha dro thibs se thib// bdag dang yon bdag glud du 'bul/ glud kyi bdag po glud 'di long*// yas bdag rnams kyis yas 'di long*// mo ngan rmi ngan ltas ngan rnams// lo zla zhag dang za ma'i kag /tsho 'phrul ltas ngan ci mchis pa// sku glud 'di yis byang bar mdzod// chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsung*// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsung*/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs du 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dag ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la phan gdags phyir// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams kun ma lus pa// thog pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/de nas sder ram snod gcig gi nang du lha'i bu'i bdud dkar po bzhag /de'i nang du shar ngos kyi gtor ma dang ngar mi changs bu mtheb skyu me rnams blangs la bzhag /'don mi mang na du yod kyi grangs blang la bzhag /de'i nang du 'bru sna dang yos bkra cung zad btab la bran/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ glud dang gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la= de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jam klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba'i lha la=mtshan bzhi brjod/ na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam bha ra sa ma bha ra hūm̐/ sngags lnga'am lan bdun brjod la/ mchod sbyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'di/ bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i lha'i bu'i bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la bsngo'o// sbyin no// bsngo zhing 'bul lo// lha'i bu'i bdud kyi gnod pa dang bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa dang gdub rtsub mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing bsgyur du gsol/ mo ngan pa dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog cig /de ltar tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga bya ste/ 'don mi mang na gtor ma dang glud kyis ma ldangs na glud dang gtor ma gsar pa bsnan pa'i med na 'bru sna dang yos bkra bsnan la bton te/ brgya ni grangs tshad yin gyi de bas mang yang legs pa las skyon du mi 'gyur bar gsungs/ brgya bzhi 'bring dang bsdus pa la ni gang bcas grangs de las mang mi dgos/ de ltar nyer lnga rdzogs nas de kha phyir bstan la/ kyai/ sngon tshe lha dbang don ched du// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub kyi// mchod sbyin phyag mthil g.yas pa ru// rgyu dang yon du 'byor pa yi// dad ldan brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin bzhag

/phyag sor bzhi la bdud bzhi bkug /thugs rjes dbang bskur nyon mongs las// sdug bsngal shes bya'i sgrib las byung*// lha bdud gsal bas mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden mthu'i byin brlabs kyis// da lta bdag dang rgyu 'byor gyis// mchod sbyin glud chen 'di bcas te// tha ma nyi shu rtsa lngas bskor// lha bdud phyag sor rtse la bzhag /gnod pa bsal phyir khyed la 'bul// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// lha bdud dkar po mthu stobs can// ci yang med pa'i gnas su dengs// shes bya'i sgrib pa las byung ba'i// lha yi bu bdud dkar po khyod// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba yi// bzung ba thong la bcing pa khrol// mnan pa khyog la bsdam pa klod// lha bdud mi la gnod gzhan du dengs// oṃ mu ne mu ne sogs/ de wa dhā tu rū dra pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces glud gtor de kha shar du kha bstan la bzhag /de nas snod nang du phung po'i bdud bzhag la/ sngar lhar lho ngos kyi gtor ma sogs dang 'bru sna btab la bran/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ glud dang gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang = de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa= de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas = de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba'i lha= mtshan bzhi brjod la/ na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ mchod sbyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i phung po'i bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la bsngo'o// sbyin no// bsngo zhing 'bul lo// phung po'i bdud kyis gnod pa dang bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa gdug rtsub mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing bsgyur du gsol/ mo ngan pa dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog cig

/gong ltar nyer lnga rdzogs nas de rab phyir bstan la/ kyai/ sngon tshe lha dbang don ched du// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub kyi// mchod sbyin phyag mthil g.yas pa ru// rgyu dang yon du 'byor pa yi// dad ldan brgya bzhi'i mchod pa bzhag /phyag sor bzhi la bdud bzhi bkug /thugs rjes dbang bskur nyon mongs las// sdug bsngal bag chags sgrib las byung*// phung po'i bdud gsal mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden mthu'i byin brlabs kyis// da lta bdag dang rgyu 'byor gyis// mchod sbyin glud chen 'di bcas te// tha ma nyi shu rtsa lngas bskor// phung bdud phyag sor rtse la bkod// gnod pa bsal phyir khyod la 'bul// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// phung bdud ser po mthu stobs can// yod min med min gnas su dengs// bag chags sgrib las byung ba yi// phung po'i bdud chen ser po khyod// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba yi// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// mnan pa khyog la bsdam pa klod// phung bdud mi la ma gnod gzhan du dengs// oṃ mu ne sogs nas de wa dhā ta rū dra pra we sha ya phaṭa kyi bar brjod/ ces lhor kha bstan la bzhag go /nyon mongs pa'i bdud sder du bzhag la/ nub ngos kyi gtor ma sogs dang 'bru sna btab la bran/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ glud dang gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta sogs gong ltar la/ mchod sbyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'di/ bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la bsngo'o// sbyin no// bsngo zhing 'bul lo// nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyis gnod pa dang bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa gdug rtsub mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing bsgyur du gsol// mo ngan pa dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog cig

/nyer lnga rdzogs nas kha phyir bstan la/ kyai/ sngon tshe lha dbang don ched du// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub kyi// mchod sbyin phyag mthil g.yas pa ru// rgyu dang yon du 'byor pa yi// dad ldan brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin bzhag /phyag sor bzhi la bdud bzhi bkug /thugs rjes dbang bskur nyon mongs las// sdug bsngal nyon mongs sgrib las byung*// nyon mongs bdud gsal mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden mtha'i byin brlabs kyis// da lta bdag dang rgyu 'byor gyis// mchod sbyin glud chen 'di bcas te// tha ma nyi shu rtsa lngas bskor// nyon bdud phyag sor rtse la bkod// gnod pa bsal phyir khyod la 'bul// bden pa chen pa'i bka' la nyon// nyon mongs bdud chen dmar po khyod// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su dengs// nyon mongs sgrib las byung ba yi// nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po khyod// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba yi// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// mnan pa khyog la bsdam pa klod// nyon bdud mi la ma gnod gzhan du dengs// oṃ mu ne nas de wa dhā tu rū dra pra we sha ya phaṭa bar brjod/ de nas kha nub tu bstan la bzhag /'chi bdag bdud sdig sder nang du bzhag go /byang ngos kyi gtor ma sogs dang 'bru sna btab la bran/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ glud dang gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta sogs gong ltar brjod la/ mchod sbyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la bsngo'o// sbyin no// bsngo zhing 'bul lo// 'chi bdag gi bdud kyis gnod pa dang bar chad bsam sbyor ngan pa gdug rtsub mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing bsgyur du gsol/

rgya g.yas pa ru// rgyu dang yon du 'byor pa yi// dad ldan brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin bzhag /phyag sor bzhi la bdud bzhi bkug /thugs rjes dbang bskur nyon mongs las// sdug bsngal las kyi sgrib las bdud phyag sor rtse la bkod// gnod pa bsal phyir khyod la 'bul// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// 'chi bdag bdud chen nag po khyod// nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su dengs// 'chi bdag las kyi sgrib las byung*// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba yi// bzung pa thong la bcings pa khrol// mnan pa khyog la bsdam pa klod// 'chi bdag mi la ma gnod gzhan du dengs// oṃ mu ne nas wa dhā tu rū dra pra we sha ya phaṭa bar gong ltar brjod/ ces kha byang du bstan la bzhag go /de nas phyag mthil gyi ngar mi de la 'bru sna dang yos bkra btab la bran/ kyai/ sngon tshe shākya thub pa yi// mchod sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru// mchod gtor rdzas dang yas bsags te// phyag sor rtse la mgron bkug nas// bdud bzhi'i mgron la sbyin pa btang*// mdzub mor lha yi bu yi bdud// gung mo'i rtse la phung po'i bdud// srin lag rtse la nyon mongs bdud// mthe'u chung la 'chi bdag bdud// rgyu dang yon du 'byor pa yi// dad ldan yon bdag phyag gi mthil// glud chen rgyan gyis spras te bzhag /gces pa 'dzad med dbang bskur nas// glud chen sbyin par btang ba'i mthus// bdud bzhi bsal te mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis// byin brlabs yon tan dpag med 'byung*// sngon tshe bskal pa thog ma la// yab rje 'khor lo drug pa de// nad ni tsi ti dz+wā lās zin// sras ni rgyal bu ma chud kyis// yab la dgongs nas brgya bzhi brtsams// brgya bzhi rgyas par glud du 'bul// shar phyogs dri za'i srid mdung chog

/rgyal po 'khor lo drug pa yab// tsi ti dz+wā lā'i nad las thar// sngon gyi de la dpe blangs nas// rgyu 'byor yon gyi bdag po yis// brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di byas pas// kag gnyan sum brgya drug bcu bzlog /shar phyogs ging gi kag gnyan bsgyur du gsol// de nas ngar mi kha phyir bstan la bzhag kyai/ da lta bdag dang yon bdag gis// gzugs dang glud chen 'di bshams te// tha ma brgya bzhi'i rdzas kyis bskor// bdud bzhi phyag sor rtse la bkod// byin gyis brlabs te bsngos shing phul// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// glud kyi gtor ma rgya chen rnams// glud bdag khyod la bsngos shing phul// tshe glud srog gi sbyin du 'bul// skye mched rigs bzhi'i gnas su dengs// lha bdud dkar po bya ba khyod// ci yang med pa'i gnas su dengs// nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po khyod// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su dengs// phung po'i bdud ni ser po khyod// yod min med min gnas su dengs// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod// nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su dengs// shes bya'i sgrib dang nyon mongs sgrib// bag chags sgrib dang las kyi sgrib// sgrib pa bzhi las byung ba yi// lha yi bdud dang nyon mongs bdud// phung po'i bdud dang 'chi bdag bdud// bdud bzhi bdud kyi rgyal po bzhi// brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la// skye mched rigs bzhi'i gnas su dengs// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// mnan pa khyog la bsdam pa klod// bdud bzhi mi la ma 'bebs gnas su dengs// sa ma ya pra we sha ya phaṭa/ yang yos bkra dang 'bru sna brdzongs pa'i tshul du btab la/ hūm̐/ gshin rje'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi brdzongs// ma mo'i dpag= yon bdag= rgyal po'i dmag = yon bdag = bdud kyi dmag = yon bdag = sa bdag dmag =

yon bdag = tshangs pa'i dmag = yon bdag = srin po'i dmag = yon bdag = gza' yi dmag = yon bdag = the'u rang dmag = yon bdag = btsan gyi dmag = yon bdag = me yi 'jigs pa = yon bdag = chu yi 'jigs pa = yon bdag = sa yi 'jigs pa = yon bdag = shing gi 'jigs pa = yon bdag = lcags kyi 'jigs pa = yon bdag= sku gsung thugs kyi glud du brdzongs// yon bdag tshe de brgya bzhi bslu// rgya 'byor yon gyi bdag po yi// ban bon rbod gtong brgya bzhis chod// klu gnyan gtad khram= dgra sna rku sna= skye bo'i ya kha= mi yi shi phro= rims gnad 'tshe ba= phyugs kyi god kha= rgyal po'i gnod pa= nyi ma ngan pa= ltas ngan rtog pa brgya= skar ngan rtog pa= mo ngan ltas ngan brgya bzhis chod/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// 'byung po mkha' 'gro ma mo'i tshogs// rgyu 'byor yon gyi bdag po la// gnod par byed pa gang yang rung*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ma lus kun// rgya chen mchod pa 'di longs la// bzung ba las ni thar bar mdzod// bcings pa las ni grol bar mdzod// rin chen glud gtor 'di bzhes la// tshe la bar du ma gcod cig /srog la ye 'grogs ma btang zhig /nad kyi pra mo ma 'debs shig /sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob na// de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyi// mar me zhal zas 'di bsnams la// bgegs kyi rgyal po 'gro bar gyis// khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste// khyod kyis bgegs kyang byed par nus// rgya chen mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi bar gyis// glud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /glud kyi gtor mas mi mgu zhing*// lus la gnod par gyur pa na// khyod kyi rtsibs log g.yas pa na// 'bras chen nad kyis zin par 'gyur// gnod sbyin nad kyis btab pa na// sha bkra'i nad kyis theb par 'gyur// lcang lo can gyi pho brang du// nam yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur te// 'byung po mang po'i tshogs pa na// stan yang thob par mi 'gyur ro// lus ngan dregs dang ldan pa yis// khyim yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// hūm̐/

nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// la la sngon gyi las las grub// la la 'phral gyi rkyen las grub// la la lha 'dre bgegs su gyur// sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob na// de ring bdag gis khyod mchod pas// rgya chen mchod sbyin 'di longs la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// phan pa'i grogs su bskyed par gyis// dge dang mi dge nam yang chud mi za// byams pa'i bsam pa nam yang chud mi za// legs par spyad na dge ba'i las// nyes par spyad na mi dge'i las// de la rnam par smin pa yod// de bas dkon mchog gsum po yi// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /rang rang gnas su bde bar dengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// de la rdo rje 'chang khros nas// spyi bo dag ni 'gems par gyur// spu gri'i so ni rnon po yis// de yi lce ni gcod par byed// mtshon cha shin tu rnon po yis// de'i sna dang rna ba gcod// 'khor lo spu gri dang 'dra ba// glad pa rab tu gshags par byed// lcags kyi tho ba 'bar ba yis// de yi snying la rab tu gzhom// rnag dang khrag ni dron mo dag /kha nas rab tu skyugs par gyur/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// mdangs dang srog dbugs khyer ba na// 'dir gnas 'byung po gang dag kyang*// mtho ste nyi zla thang la lhung yang srid// dma' ste sa gzhi nam mkhar bkyag kyang srid// nag ste bya rog dkar po bsgyur yang srid// byas pa'i las ni nam yang chud mi za// brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di 'bul bas// chu yi kag gnyan gdug pa bzlog /sngon tshe nags tshal dgon pa shing drung du// 'phags pa chen po kun dga' bos// bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la skyabs// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// nyon cig yi dwags kha 'bar ma// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la// 'phags pa'i tshe la bar chad ma byed cig

/bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar bsngos pa yis// yi dwags stong phrag rnams 'grangs shing*// ngoms shing tshims par gyur nas kyang*// 'phags pa dga' bo bdud las thar// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs longs spyod 'phel// brgya bzhi mthu dang ldan pa yi// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'dis// byang phyogs chu yi gnod pa bzlog /sngon gyi gling gzhi de bzhin du// de ring rgyu 'byor yon bdag gi /bar chad rkyen rnams bsgyur du gsol// brgya bzhi 'di yi mthu stobs kyis// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// gshin rje ma mo rgyal po dang*// gnod sbyin bdud dang sa bdag dang*// the'u rang srin po gza' dang ni// mi dang mi ma yin la sogs// 'byung po'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol// gnam lo rgyal po'i kag babs dang*// spar kha'i bdun zur ngan pa dang*// sa chu me rlung 'jigs pa rnams// brgya bzhi 'di yis bzlog tu gsol// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu= rmi lam than ltas ngan pa= lo kag zla kag zhag kag= che bdud chung sri bsgyur du gsol// god kha god 'dre= de bzhin bdag la gang 'tshe ba// brgya bzhi 'di yis bzlog tu gsol/ hūm̐/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams brgya bzhis bzlog /nyi khri chig stong rkyen rnams= dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad= ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu= glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig= bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams= ban de'i sngags sor brgya bzhis bzlog /bon po'i brda zor= bal po'i ngan sngags/ zhang zhung dzo dpal= sa ye byol po= sum pa'i glang zor= btsan gyi dal kha= ma mo'i rbod gtong= gshin rje'i khram kha= bdud kyi byol po= klu yi byad kha= phur pa'i dpal 'debs brgya bzhis= yas kyi bdud g.yos brgya bzhis zlog /mas kyi sri langs// pha tshan rgyab 'dre= dar tshan stong 'dre=

gnam gyi dpal 'debs= sa yi sri langs= rked la brag ral= rtsibs la shing chags= bar snang btsan g.yos= ltas ngan brgya cu= sha ba ru 'dzings bdud kyi byol// bya rgod lder 'dzings rgyal po'i= g.yag po ru 'dzings dmu yi= nya mo rnga 'dzings klu yi= ltas ngan byol bzhi brgya bzhis bzlog /srod la srin byas phrug phrug zer// bdud kyi bu mo'i ltas ngan yin// de yang brgya bzhis bzlog tu gsol// rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// phyi gza' gshin rje'i khram la btab pa brgya bzhis bzlog /nang gza' gshin po'i ngos blangs= bar gza' bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pa= phyogs mtshams 'dre lnga bdud gcod thams cad bsgyur// gnam sgo sa sgo thams cad brgya bzhis bsgyur// lo yi bdun zur thams cad= mo ngan rmi ngan thams cad= chags che nyam nga thams cad= ban de'i phur kha thams cad= gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba= mtshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa= 'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa= ma mo'i khrag nad dal yams= rgyal po'i smyo 'bog btang ba// srin po'i sho kha ston pa= bdud kyi khram la 'debs pa= btsan gyi zhags pa 'debs pa= gshin rje'i rtsis la 'debs pa= dri za'i mig phur btsugs pa= klu yi byad du bcug pa= rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa= the'u rang tshe la rku ba= mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa= ma mo'i bsam ngan gdug rtsub= ban de'i phur zor 'phen pa= bon po'i dpal zor 'phen pa= zhang zhung dzo dmar 'phen pa= sum pas rtsang zor 'phen pa= skye bo'i mda' zor 'phen pa= pha mas rgyud kyi dgra 'dre thams cad= glo bur gnod pa'i 'gong 'dre thams cad= 'gong po 'gong 'dre'i bar chad= bse rag tshe la rku ba= rus kyi gshed bzhi mchis pa= nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= bud med dmod zer 'phen pa= mthu gtad khram kha thams cad= sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad= bdud dang gshin rje srin po dang*// btsan dang rgyal po'i bsen mo dang*// klu dang gnod sbyin 'byung po dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i bgegs rnams brgya bzhis bzlog

/mi bdud thad dkar ma btang zhig /rta bdud srab khar ma btang = /phyugs bdud nga bar ma btang = glo bur ye 'grogs ma btang*// gnod byed 'byung po thams cad brgya bzhis bzlog /oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag cag la sdang ba thams cad ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de nas lha'i bu'i bdud shar/ 'chi bdag gi bdud lho/ nyon mongs bdud nub/ phung po'i bdud byang du bskyal/ ngar mi che ba de nad pa yin na lo bdud steng ngam/ 'dre lnga bdud gcod kyi phyogs su bskyal lo// bde rim yin na yas lam mam gtsang sar bskyal lo// de nas rjes chog ni/ oṃ shākya mu na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod la/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyis bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs spyi ltar brjod mthar/ mdun bskyed thub pa'i gtso 'khor ye shes pa rnams// sku gzugs dang tshwa tshwa 'di rnams la ji srid 'byung ba lnga'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ dam tshig pa bdag gi snying gar thim/ bdag nyid kyang mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// tshwa tshwa khang pa'i ltag ma yin par byang ngam nub phyogs chu thub pa'i sar bskyal/ rdul tshon yin na bsdus la khang pa'i thog tu spungs bar bshad do// shog bur bris pa yin na sbra'i gong ngam khang pa'i lcam la lan gsum sbyar zhing*/ thub pa'i phyag gis bsrung bya rnams bkab pa'i mos pa bya/ phyag dang bdud bzhi'i tsakli rgyun du tshag rung ngo*/ thub pas mdzad par grags pa'i gzhung las/ mo ngan chags che bdud kyis zin// de la brgya bzhi bya bar gsungs// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// sdig pa byang nas sdug bsngal zhi// brgya bzhi'i cho ga byas pa yis// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/

zhes dang*/ chos rje sha ra ba nas brgyud pa'i yig rnying las/ tshogs rdzogs bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'o// brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di nad tshab chen po 'byung ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan byung ba dang*/ god kha che ba dang*/ mo brtsis ngan pa dang*/ byad kha chen po sdig pa dang*/ mtsher rtsub chen po thams cad la shis so// zhes gsungs so// e ma ho// zhal nas gsungs pa'i brgya bzhi'i cho ga zhes// kun gyi rtsod med nyi zla lta bur grags// thub pas gsungs pa'i 'di yin mdo bran dang*// phyag rdor gyis gsungs 'di yi rgyun chung gnyis// yod pas 'dug kyang bod du ma 'gyur bas// bka' 'gyur nang du mi bzhugs mthong thos med// de yi man ngag brgya bzhi bya ba'i tshul// kha che paṇ+ḍi ta yis mdzad pa dang*// ba ri lo tsās mdzad gnyis gsungs btsun yang 'khrugs che phyag len mi gsal lag len dka'// deng sang brgya bzhi dar srol che na yang*// ma nor ci bzhin shes pa nyin skar tsam// mdo lugs brgya bzhi byed mkhan rab byung dgos/ sngags lugs yin kyang de nyin gdan cig bsrungs// dbus su maṇ+ḍal steng du thub sku bshams// de rgyab brgya bzhi rim pa bzhin bskor nas// de rgyab mchod yon snod ni bcu gnyis bshams// brgya bzhi bsngo ba mgron rigs bzhi kar bsngo// tshar dus bsrung phyir tshwa tshwa thog khar spungs// de ni mdo lugs yin par shes bya ste/ deng sang gtor chog sngags pa rnams kyis byed// gdan gcig bsrung ba'ang dka' phyir 'dir ma bshad/ bshos bu ngar mi mar me tshwa tshwa rnams// phyogs bzhir gshams zhing phul dus phyogs bzhir bskyal// rgyang bu mda' dang nam mkha' bshos bu bzhi// dkyil 'khor du bshams sngon du lha gzhung bsrang*// chos skyong las byang tshar rjes brgya bzhi 'don// rting 'phul chos skyong dmar gtor 'bul dgos pa// sngags lugs yin te 'di ni nyin gcig to// yin phyir lha gzhung la sogs 'don long med// de phyir 'di ni mdo sngags zung 'jug lugs// stabs bde phyag len gsal zhing gab 'khrugs med// phyi rabs dge bshes sngags chung mang po la// phan pa'i sems bskyed bzang pos kun bslangs te// rā ga a s+yas legs par bsgrigs pa yi// yi ge pha ni brtson 'grus zhes byas bris// nyes 'gal mchis na mtshan ldan rnams la bshags// dge bas ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar// 'di nyid mi nub phyogs bcur 'phel zhing rgyas// tshe zad nad pa mang po'i tshe bsring zhing*// 'brel thogs kun gyi bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi// bla med byang chub dam pa myur thob shog
